description: This entity defines the type of AP INVOICE such as AP invoice expense, AP reimbursable expense (employee expense reports), AP recurring expense, or other invoice expense.

name: AR_INVOICE

description: Defines quantity and unit of measure by various types of quantities to a specific AR INVOICE LINE. Examples of quantity types are credited, invoiced, and ordered.

name: AR_INVOICE_LINE_RECEIPT
description: Further classifies an invoice line payment as an amount collected related to a specific line item on an accounts receivable invoice.

description: Table to hold all the line types for the INVOICEs in AR. Defines the type of invoice line.  Examples: - Chargeback - Charges - Freight - Line - DM-reversal - Tax

description: Contains the list of all the in-use AR INVOICE TYPEs.  Examples of invoice types are invoice, invoice local, invoice state, and projects credit memo.

name: BANK_TRANSFER_EVENT_TYPE
description: A code for the type of bank transfer event such as interbank event or intrabank event.

name: BOND_PAYMENT_SCHEDULE

name: CARD_STATEMENT

description: This entity shows metrics for a given account access device (e.g., credit card plastic) for a given account for a given statement.  Example of metrics include purchase amount, cash advance amount, purchase count, and cash advance request count.

name: CHECK_TRANSACTION_TYPE
description: This minor entity identifies the different types of transaction types for checks as used at the home bank.

name: CLAIM_EXPOSURE_ACTIVITY_PAYMENT_TYPE
description: This is a classification of payment types such as working, final or supplemental.

name: CLAIM_IVR_STEP_TRANSACTION
description: This links the claim to the IVR step transaction.

name: CLAIM_PAYMENT_TYPE
description: A code for the claim transaction type.  Examples are claim medical payment, claim legal payment, claim auto body payment, expense payment, reserve transaction, salvage transaction, subrogation transaction, and reinsurance recovery transaction.

name: COA_MONETARY_BALANCE
description: This entity carries the aggregate monetary balance of the CHART OF ACCOUNTS CODE. For example, $100,000 was the ending monetary amount of long-term receivables.

name: COLLECTION_DEBT_INVOICE
description: This is an agreement where the financial institution agrees to collect debt from its customer (the issuer) usually for a fee. description: A CONSOLIDATED INVOICE represents a collection of multiple INVOICEs for single payment or customer billing.

name: CONSOLIDATED_INVOICE_STATUS
description: This entity tracks the status of a CONSOLIDATED INVOICE, such as canceled, approved, pending, send, hold, and release.

name: CONSOLIDATED_INVOICE_SUMMARY
description: This entity contains summary account information as of this summary date. name: EVENT_PAYMENT_INSTRUCTION
description: This relates the payment instruction to the actual payment event.

name: FILE_TRANSFER
description: This entity captures information regarding online applications that enable visitors to transfer files.

name: FINANCIAL_EVENT_JOURNAL_ENTRY_LINE
description: This entity links a financial event amount to the journal entry lines that it may generate. With double entry bookkeeping, one financial event can have more than one journal entry.

name: FIXED_INCOME_INTEREST_PAYMENT

name: FORM_OF_PAYMENT_TYPE

name: FREIGHT_TERM_TYPE_INVOICE_XREF

name: FUNDS_TRANSFER_EVENT
description: This entity captures information regarding the partial or complete discharge of an obligation typically by its settlement in the form of a transfer of funds applied against the monetary value of the debtor's obligation. Payments may be applied against obligations represented by one or more invoices.

description: This entity describes ways in which funds transfers are conveyed to payers. Receipt method tells how the receipt for an invoice will be treated; processing can be manual or automatic, for example, lockbox, check, and wire transfer.

name: FUNDS_TRANSFER_TYPE
description: Classifies a funds transfer as pertaining to an invoice or other type.  Other payment types could include shopping transactions, or to fulfill the terms and conditions of any contracts that exist between the company and its parties and channels.

name: GL_PROJECT_SEGMENT
description: The entity that indicates the GL PROJECT SEGMENT of the accounts used in financial reporting for a company.

name: HEALTH_BILLING_CODE
description: A detailed level of billing codes on a claim submitted from a facility.  (HCFA 1450 field 42)

name: HEALTH_BILLING_TYPE
description: A domain of the highest-level codes used to describe a billing cost center.

name: INTEREST_PAYMENT_METHOD_TYPE_JAPAN
description: This is the method for interest payment such as issue a check, deposit into another account, or compound into this account.

name: INVESTMENT_HOLDING_STATEMENT

name: INVESTMENT_STATEMENT_LINE_ITEM_METRIC
description: This entity represents metrics at the line item level for investment trades within a portfolio. This can include the number of units traded, the sales price, the commission price, and fees.

name: INVOICE_STATUS
description: This entity tracks the status of an INVOICE, such as canceled, approved, pending, send, hold, and release.

name: STATEMENT_MAIL_TYPE
